purpose: Test whether a same-day adjusted-close cross above the smoothed KAMA-style adaptive line improves next-day continuation and executable returns inside financing-balance Top10 candidates with at least two consecutive increases.

selection.availability_gate: same-date margin data must have feature_available_date equal to the next trading session
selection.signal_information_time: after the exchange publishes signal-date margin data before the next session opens
selection.entry: next legal raw-price open on feature_available_date

signals.primary_current_cross: current adjusted close > current ADP and previous valid adjusted close <= previous valid ADP
signals.rising_line_sensitivity: primary current cross and current ADP > previous valid ADP
signals.prior_cross_support_control: previous valid close crossed above ADP and current adjusted low remains above current ADP

outcomes.next_close_up: signal D1 adjusted close > signal-date adjusted close
outcomes.entry_day_gross_up: signal D1 adjusted close > executable D1 adjusted open; diagnostic only because T+1 forbids sale
outcomes.legal_one_day: enter D1 open and request D2 close with legal-sale deferral and exact double-slippage costs
